description: Dublin City Council (Dublin Fire Brigade) publishes the fire stations of the Dublin Fire Brigade across the Dublin region, with station ID and name, Irish Transverse Mercator and Irish Grid coordinates, address, Eircode, call sign, and latitude and longitude. Coverage: the Dublin region, Ireland; the portal holds a 2021 and a 2025 file and a live datastore table, and the record was last modified on 2026-06-25. Format and access: CSV, KML, DB_TABLE, WMS, downloadable without registration from the Smart Dublin open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: it lists stations only, not fire-engine numbers, staffing or response areas; the number of stations was not counted. Simulation uses: siting and coverage analysis of emergency response, travel-time isochrones from stations, and emergency-service resilience in flood or outage scenarios. Related catalogue records: Dublin Fire Brigade fire and ambulance incident activity logs (2011 to 2025) (data-dublin-fire-brigade-ambulance-incident-data).
